services.name: Moab Zipline Adventure
services.desc: Start your Moab zipline adventure with a scenic 2-mile off-road UTV ride through rugged desert terrain, setting the stage for an unforgettable experience. Once you arrive, you’ll soar across 6 thrilling ziplines and cross a suspension bridge, taking in sweeping views of the surrounding landscape. This 2-3 hour guided tour is designed to give you a unique perspective of Moab, both on the ground and high above it. Our expert guides handle every detail, from securing your gear to managing your speed on each line, so you can focus on the fun and take in the views with confidence. blurb: Guests experience zipline tours over Moab's red rock terrain with expert guides emphasizing safety and hospitality. Tours include a 2 mile off-road trail to 6 ziplines ranging from mild to wild, a sunset zipline tour, and a challenge course with highlines and space nets. The experience includes breathtaking views and relaxing moments around a fire with s'mores at sunset.
